passages.text: ANIMAL SPIRITS, a fine subtile fluid, supposed to be separated from the blood in the brain, and conveyed by the nerves to every part of the body, as the instrument of sensation and muscular motion.

Their existence has never been demonstrated, for no fluid has been found in the nerves even by the best microscopes; yet the hypothesis is retained by many as the easiest explanation of the phenomena.
Some late authors have supposed the nervous power to be of the same nature with the electric fluid.
